_note: The default castle (Z4, 2026-11-19; blueprint v6 (2026-11-19: v5 packed about a third tighter, same parts): 28 by 31 cells, the top 6 rows sea for the dock). Units: town cells (11 world units), x east, z south, sea side north (z 0); sim/frontier/castle.js turns it by quarter turns so the sea side meets the site's harbour. A rect is [x0, z0, x1, z1] in cells, x1 and z1 not included. The keep stands on cell `hall`, the middle of the castle's town grid. Wall and gate cells are the normal town kinds (they can be broken); moat cells block everyone and cannot be broken. Terraces: a terrace edge is a thin cliff on the cell line (town_grid.js blocks every edge between two levels, and it cannot be broken); the terrace's outer ring of cells is its wall, `gate` the cut in it, `ramp` the land bridge that rises to the gate from the level below. A terrace with `open` is the older thick kind (a ring of cliff cells with the wall inside it). Yards 2 to 3 cells between walls; both land bridges are 2 cells long; the keep is 6 cells a side.

approach._note: open ground in front of the drawbridge (where the castle_test dev save starts)

highGround._note: placeholder, to tune (Z4h): a shooter on a castle terrace reaches this share of its range further for each level it stands above its target (sim/castles.js rangeScale)

_special: placeholder mapping, checked against the clans' real special buildings in Z4d
